title: Nature study camp, day 1
storyboard: Film: kids arriving at camp gate, guide's briefing circle, torch-lit night walk (3 vertical shots)

scenes.headline: 6:00 AM — dawn bird walk
scenes.body: A common kingfisher waits on its perch, watching the water for small fish.

scenes.headline: Sitting quietly with a langur troop
scenes.body: Higher-ranking gray langurs groom, and get groomed, more often.

scenes.headline: Pond session: dragonfly ID
scenes.body: Notebooks out: colour, wing spots, where it perched.

scenes.headline: Night walk: who's awake?
scenes.body: Torches low, voices lower — the night shift is on.

scenes.headline: Day 2: into the forest
scenes.body: Muddy Lessons nature study camps · Bengaluru

caption:
Day 1 of nature study camp, in 15 seconds.

The kingfisher on our dawn walk has a big appetite: common kingfishers eat around 60% of their body weight every day.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Alcedo atthis, Semnopithecus entellus). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Day-in-the-life vlog recast as a camp day: timestamps carry the story, real species clips are the B-roll; guide/kid shots come from the storyboard.
